'''Vuundalla''' was a [[planet]]<ref name="Aftershock" /> located in the [[Bri'ahl sector]]<ref name="Appendix" /> within [[the galaxy]]. The planet was ruled by [[Pychor Vuundir]] and [[Dafne Vuundir]].<ref name="Aftershock" />

{{Planet-stub}}
==Behind the scenes==
The initial version of the [[2025]] [[Star Systems of the Galaxy]] appendix placed Vuundalla in the [[Tungra sector]] in grid square K-18,<ref name="Appendix" /> but the [[October 13]]<ref name="Substack 2">{{Substack|subdomain=jasonfry|url=p/star-wars-galaxy-map-update|text=Star Wars Galaxy Map Update|name=[[Jason Fry]]|username=jasonfry|date=2025-10-13}}</ref> iteration moved it to the Bri'ahl sector in grid square I-17<ref name="Appendix" /> to match its placement in the ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]''.<ref name="AVG">''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]''</ref>
